name: zdi_index_to_ptr_or_null
description: zDi::IndexToPtrOrNull maps serialized DI pool indexes to live zDi slots, returning null for negative indexes.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel DI pool/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4815a0 validates negative-index null handling and zDiPartial pointer calculation from g_zModel_DiPoolBase using the recovered slot stride.
The native zDi ref/free smoke verifies -1 returns null and index 1 resolves to the expected g_zModel_DiPoolBase slot.
